title: Curriculum-Grounded Diagram Generation with Model Selection
description: Add OpenRouter provider support with per-request model selection for diagram generation, then extract textbook diagrams from Ethiopian biology PDFs (grades 7-12) as ground truth for curriculum-aligned diagram labeling and validation.

userStories.title: Add OpenRouter provider
userStories.description: As a user, I want the system to support OpenRouter models so I can choose from a wider range of LLMs for diagram generation.
acceptanceCriteria: OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, OPENROUTER_DEFAULT_MODEL configurable via .env
OpenRouterProvider subclass of OpenAIProvider with HTTP-Referer and X-Title headers
Registered in ProviderManager._init_providers() with fallback priority after Ollama
OpenRouter models visible in GET /models and POST /models/health responses
Ruff, mypy, pytest pass
userStories.notes: New file: src/llm/providers/openrouter.py. Modify: src/config.py, src/llm/manager.py, .env.example.

userStories.title: Thread preferred_model through diagram call chain
userStories.description: As a developer, I need preferred_model to flow from the API endpoint through to ProviderManager.route() so model selection actually works.
acceptanceCriteria: preferred_model param added to DiagramAgent.generate()
preferred_model param added to BaseAgent._call_llm()
preferred_model param added to ModelRouter.route()
Param passed through to ProviderManager.route() which already accepts it
When preferred_model is None, existing default behavior is preserved
Ruff, mypy, pytest pass
userStories.notes: Files: src/agents/diagram.py, src/agents/base.py, src/llm/router.py. The ProviderManager.route() already accepts preferred_model.

userStories.title: Add model field to diagram schemas and API
userStories.description: As a user, I want to specify which model to use for diagram generation via the API.
acceptanceCriteria: DiagramGenerateRequest.model: Optional[str] = None
Endpoint passes request.model as preferred_model to agent
Response echoes model_used (set by provider after actual model selected)
Schema validation allows any non-empty string for model
When model is None, uses default (Ollama)
Tests verify model threading at schema, agent, and API layer
Ruff, mypy, pytest pass

userStories.title: Add model selector to diagram dashboard UI
userStories.description: As a student, I want to pick which AI model generates my diagram from a dropdown in the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Model dropdown in diagram page populated from GET /models endpoint
Selected model sent with generate request
model_used shown in response metadata (e.g., 'ollama/gemma4:31b-cloud')
Dropdown defaults to system default model
Loading state while fetching model list
tsc --noEmit passes, Next.js build passes
Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools
userStories.notes: File: dashboard/src/app/diagrams/page.tsx. Fetch /models on mount, populate a select dropdown alongside topic/difficulty.

userStories.title: Textbook figure extraction pipeline
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to extract diagrams, figures, and illustrations from the Ethiopian biology PDF textbooks as reference images.
acceptanceCriteria: New module src/ingestion/diagram_extractor.py uses Docling layout analysis to detect figures on each PDF page
Extracted figures saved as JPEG (quality 85) to data/diagrams/{grade}/{source_file}_{figure_number}.jpg
Caption text extracted alongside each figure
Metadata recorded: grade, unit, topic, figure_number, page_number, source_file
Script scripts/ingest_diagrams.py processes all grades (9-12) with progress logging
Grades 7-8 pipeline stubbed — logs message and skips gracefully when no PDFs found
Unit and topic mapped from PDF document structure (not regex from text)
Ruff, mypy pass
userStories.notes: Uses docling >=2.12.0 (already a dependency). New files: src/ingestion/diagram_extractor.py, scripts/ingest_diagrams.py.

userStories.title: Textbook diagram storage and retrieval
userStories.description: As a developer, I want extracted diagrams stored in the database with searchable metadata so the system can retrieve relevant diagrams by grade and topic.
acceptanceCriteria: TextbookDiagram DB model with: id (UUID PK), grade_level, unit, topic, caption, image_path, figure_number, page_number, source_file, ground_truth_labels (JSON, nullable), created_at
Figure captions embedded via sentence-transformers and indexed in ChromaDB with source_type: 'textbook_diagram'
GET /diagram/textbook?grade=&topic= endpoint returns matching diagrams with image URLs and captions
Endpoint returns 200 with empty list when no matches (graceful degradation for grades 7-8)
Tests verify model, endpoint, and retrieval
Ruff, mypy, pytest pass
userStories.notes: Files: src/database/models.py, src/retrieval/adapter.py (extend ChromaDB indexing for diagram captions), src/api/diagram.py (new GET endpoint), tests/. Image serving via static files or base64.

userStories.title: Auto-generate ground truth labels from textbook diagrams
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a pipeline that uses vision-capable LLMs to analyze each extracted textbook diagram and generate structured labels serving as ground truth for validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/label_textbook_diagrams.py processes all extracted diagrams
Uses OpenRouter vision models (gpt-4o, claude-3.5-sonnet) as primary with Ollama vision fallback (llava, gemma4)
Vision prompt instructs LLM to output JSON labels: [{id, text, x, y}] matching diagram structures
Generated labels stored in TextbookDiagram.ground_truth_labels
Labels marked as proposed: true initially, with human_reviewed: false flag
Script accepts --model flag to override which vision model to use
Graceful fallback: if both OpenRouter and Ollama vision fail, skip diagram with warning
Ruff, mypy pass
userStories.notes: New files: scripts/label_textbook_diagrams.py, src/agents/diagram.py (add auto_label_textbook_diagram static method). Data flow: load image -> encode as base64 -> send to vision LLM -> parse JSON labels -> store in DB.

userStories.title: Curriculum-aligned diagram generation with RAG
userStories.description: As a student, I want AI-generated diagrams to use correct Ethiopian biology curriculum terminology and conventions by referencing the textbook.
acceptanceCriteria: DiagramAgent.generate() retrieves relevant textbook chunks + diagram captions via ChromaDB before calling LLM
Retrieved context injected into the system prompt as curriculum reference material
Generated labels use terminology from the textbook, not arbitrary AI choices
Response includes textbook_references: [{grade, unit, figure_number, caption}] when textbook matches found
When no textbook content matches, falls back to current behavior (no RAG context)
Tests verify RAG context injection
Ruff, mypy, pytest pass
userStories.notes: File: src/agents/diagram.py (modify generate()). Schema: src/schemas/diagram.py (add textbook_references to response). Requires US-006 first for the retrieval index.

userStories.title: Ground truth diagram validation endpoint
userStories.description: As a student, I want my label submissions validated against actual textbook diagrams when available, so I learn the curriculum's official terminology.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /diagram/validate accepts optional textbook_diagram_id: Optional[str]
When textbook_diagram_id provided, validates against TextbookDiagram.ground_truth_labels instead of submitted correct_labels
Response includes source field: 'textbook' or 'ai_generated'
When textbook_diagram_id is None, uses current behavior (correct_labels from AI generation)
Error handling: returns 404 if textbook_diagram_id not found, 400 if textbook diagram has no ground truth labels
Tests cover: textbook validation path, fallback path, error cases
Ruff, mypy, pytest pass
userStories.notes: Files: src/api/diagram.py, src/schemas/diagram.py, src/agents/diagram.py (validate_labels extended). Requires US-007 for populated ground_truth_labels.
